name: mc_export
title: Export blocks to a file
description:
Writes the blocks of a box to plugins/Ashlar/exports/<name>.json.gz for offline editing, rebuilding or later comparison. Read-only in the world.

WHEN TO USE: to keep an exact copy of an area larger than mc_inspect returns (default limit 4,000,000 blocks), then rebuild it with mc_build {cellsFile:name} or compare it with mc_diff {against:{expectedFile:name}}.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for statistics or a quick look (mc_inspect, mc_render); as a rollback point (mc_build snapshot:true or mc_snapshot); sign text, inventories and entities are not exported.

PARAMETERS: from/to, optional world, name ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}; overwrite:true replaces). format "cells" (default): {format, world, bounds, cells:[[x,y,z,"state"],...]}; skipAir:true leaves out air (a rebuild then never clears). "palette-rle": {bounds, order "y,z,x", palette, runs:[[paletteIndex,count],...]}, much smaller. canonical (default true) drops default-valued properties.

SIDE EFFECTS: writes one file; only the 20 newest exports are kept. Tick-budgeted region reads may load chunks; encoding runs off the main thread. Boxes over limits.max-export-volume are rejected before reading.

world.description: World name; default: the configured default world.

skipAir.description: cells format: leave out air cells (default false).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing export of this name (default false).
